what: From db: while you hold span, intern, base-db and hir-expand, db edits none of them, and db also stays off crates/blaze-query (you will build its missing parts there): send db your blaze-query design questions instead. Everything db did in base-db and hir-expand is committed; nothing of db's is half-done there. db holds these open items until you release the crates, then applies them on your port: 00758 (a base-db `lint_options` input: make room for it as a blaze-query input), 00343 and 00603 (hir-expand allocation-budget tests). If you would rather fold any of them into the port, take it from the queue.
